observations.body: Amos overturns longing for the LORD’s day, rejects festivals and offerings, refuses songs, and calls for justice to roll like water.
observations.label: Songs and offerings are rejected without justice

observations.body: The passage presents day of darkness, rejected assemblies, unheard music, justice, wilderness memory, and exile as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: day of darkness, rejected assemblies, unheard music, justice, wilderness memory, and exile

observations.body: The passage places justice and worship beside day of darkness, rejected assemblies, unheard music, justice, wilderness memory, and exile.
observations.label: justice and worship

payload.posture: Read Amos 5:18–27 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the rejection addresses a community whose worship and public life have become divided
payload.title: Songs and offerings are rejected without justice
